app.name: Pinterest: Lifestyle Ideas
app.description: Visual discovery and bookmarking platform for lifestyle ideas.

verdict.one_liner: Extensive ad data sharing with third parties, though some privacy controls are available.
verdict.summary: Pinterest collects detailed behavioral data and shares it with advertising networks and social media platforms. While users can opt out of targeted ads and delete their accounts, the default privacy posture is heavily weighted toward data collection and profiling.
verdict.recommendation_reason: If you value privacy, consider limiting Pinterest's data collection through its Privacy and Data Settings, or use it only in a browser with strong ad blockers.

red.title: Your offsite activity may power Pinterest ads
red.plain_english: Pinterest states that it customizes ads by identifying your interests based on your onsite and offsite activities, and may receive information about your visits to advertiser sites through the Pinterest Tag.

red.title: Your data is shared with Facebook, Google, and other ad platforms
red.plain_english: Pinterest states that it discloses cookie IDs, your IP address, or a hashed version of your email address to third parties such as Facebook Ads and Google Marketing Platform for advertising purposes.

red.title: Your Pins may train AI models
red.plain_english: Pinterest states that it uses information, including images in Pins posted to its Services, to train and improve its machine learning and generative AI models regardless of when those Pins were posted. It does not clearly explain how to opt out of this training specifically.

red.title: Your contacts may be processed by Pinterest
red.plain_english: If you previously chose to sync your contacts, Pinterest states that it will continue to process certain information about your contacts who are Pinterest users to help you find one another on its Services.

green.title: You can turn off personalized ads
green.plain_english: Pinterest lets you opt out of targeted advertising and data sharing for ad purposes in your Privacy and Data Settings.

green.title: You can fully delete your account
green.plain_english: Pinterest provides a settings option to close your account and delete your data.

green.title: Strong data rights for European users
green.plain_english: Residents of the EEA, UK, and Switzerland get GDPR rights including access, portability, and objection to processing.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: Camera access is used only if you opt in to photo search through your device settings. The policy does not clearly explain what camera data is collected or stored.
categories.detail: The app requests camera access for photo search. The policy indicates this is user-initiated but does not describe camera data handling.
categories.policy_excerpt: Allow searching with photos... You can opt in to this in your device operating system settings.
concerns: Policy does not clearly explain camera data collection or storage

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: Pinterest states that it uses your IP address to infer your approximate location even if you do not share precise location, and may use this to customize your experience such as showing nearby retailers' Pins.
categories.detail: Precise location is optional via device settings, but IP-based location inference happens continuously.
categories.policy_excerpt: We use your IP address to infer your approximate location, even if you don't choose to share your precise location.

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: If you previously chose to sync your contacts, Pinterest states that it processes certain information about your contacts who are Pinterest users to help you find one another.
categories.detail: Contact syncing is opt-in but processes contact data on Pinterest servers.
categories.policy_excerpt: If you previously chose to sync your contacts with your account, we will continue to process certain information about your contacts who are Pinterest users.

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: Pinterest collects visual information through the images that you post to its services. The policy does not clearly explain whether the app accesses your full photo library or only images you choose to upload.
categories.detail: File access is user-initiated for saving or uploading Pins and photos, but the scope of access is not clearly described.
categories.policy_excerpt: We collect information when you save or upload Pins, photos, or other content

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Pinterest states that it discloses cookie IDs, your IP address, or a hashed version of your email address to third parties such as Facebook Ads and Google Marketing Platform for advertising, and may share data with partners to show you ads on and off Pinterest.
categories.detail: Data is shared with advertisers, analytics providers, social media platforms, and third-party partners for ad targeting both on and off Pinterest.
categories.policy_excerpt: we disclose information such as cookie IDs, your IP address, or a hashed version of your email address to third parties, such as Facebook Ads, Google Marketing Platform, and others.
concerns: Cannot opt out of all sharing while keeping account

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: Pinterest collects your name, email, birthday, gender, and interests when you create an account. The policy does not clearly explain whether this account information is used for advertising profiles.
categories.detail: Standard account information is collected at signup. Business accounts may also collect race/ethnicity if added.
categories.policy_excerpt: When you join our Services, we collect information like your name, email address, birthday, gender, country of residence, your interests, and preferred language.
concerns: Business accounts may collect race/ethnicity data
Policy does not clearly explain if account data is used for ads

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: Pinterest states that it customizes ads by identifying your interests based on your onsite and offsite activities, and receives information about your activity outside Pinterest from advertisers and partners.
categories.detail: Behavioral tracking includes onsite activity and offsite activity via the Pinterest Tag and partner data.
categories.policy_excerpt: we customize the ads we show you by identifying your interests based on your onsite and offsite activities, as well as by using information we receive from ad partners or other third parties.
concerns: Offsite activity used for ad targeting
Behavioral profile built from partner data

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: Children under 13 are not allowed to use Pinterest. The policy does not explain how age is verified.
categories.detail: The policy states a 13+ age requirement but does not explain how age is verified.
categories.policy_excerpt: Children under 13 are not allowed to use Pinterest.

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: Pinterest states that its log data includes your IP address, browser type, and activity on websites that use Pinterest features like the Save button.
categories.detail: Log data includes IP address, browser settings, activity on third-party sites with Pinterest widgets, and date/time of access.
categories.policy_excerpt: This log data includes, for example, your Internet Protocol (IP) address, activity on websites you visit that incorporate Pinterest features... browser type and settings, and the date and time of when you accessed the Services.
concerns: Activity logged across websites with Save button

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: Pinterest collects information about the device you use, including its type, operating system, settings, and unique device identifiers. It does not clearly explain whether this is used to fingerprint your device.
categories.detail: Device info collection is standard but includes unique device identifiers. The purpose for persistent tracking is not clearly explained.
categories.policy_excerpt: We collect information about the device you use to access our Services, including the type of device, operating system, network service provider, settings, and unique device identifiers.
concerns: Purpose of device data not clearly explained

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy does not mention health or biometric data.
categories.detail: No health or biometric data collection is mentioned in the privacy policy.

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy does not mention financial or payment data.
categories.detail: No financial or payment information collection is mentioned in the privacy policy.

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: You can delete your account and request data deletion through your settings. The policy does not clearly explain whether information shared with advertising partners is also deleted.
categories.detail: Deletion is available in settings, but Pinterest notes some data may be retained for legal or safety purposes.
categories.policy_excerpt: You can have your information deleted. In your settings, select 'Delete your data and account' and follow the instructions.
concerns: Some data retained after deletion for legal reasons
Policy does not explain partner data deletion

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: Pinterest may change its policy at any time and continued use counts as acceptance. It states that significant changes may get a more prominent notice.
categories.detail: Policy changes are posted on the policy page. Continued use equals acceptance. Material changes may receive email notice.
categories.policy_excerpt: If you continue to use Pinterest after those changes are in effect, the new policy applies to you. If the changes are significant, we may provide a more prominent notice, such as by sending you an email.
